cells.title: Skip the hub publish of a skill already active with the same files
cells.action: RED FIRST: in the onboard plan tests (find the existing --skillstation switch tests that call set_test_hub), add a test where the injected hub answers `skill show <id> --json` for bee-deploying and for every bee-principle-* of the test engine with manifest.status active and manifest.resources whose path is `skills/default/<id>/<rel>` and digest `sha256:<hex of the engine file rendered for claude>`. Plan with skillstation on and the claude runtime: assert zero publish_skillstation items, AND that the after_publish remove_skill items for the principles and the set_principles_hub item are still planned (D3). Add cases: one principle whose hub digest differs -> exactly that principle gets a publish item; one skill missing (runner error containing `skill not found`) -> it gets an item; one skill draft -> it gets an item; a hub runner that fails with any other reason -> every item kept (D2). Run the new test and watch it fail because 25-style items are planned today; record the red output. FIX: in skillstation_group.rs add the resource set to Hub (Vec of (rel path after the `<id>/` segment, hex digest without the `sha256:` prefix), parsed from manifest.resources; missing resources gives an empty set). In plan.rs add one helper that decides whether a skill needs a publish: hub_show via hub_runner(repo_root); Missing -> publish; Skip -> publish; status != active -> publish; else compare the sorted set from walk_skill_tree(engine.skills_root.join(id), Some(render claude)).files with the hub set; equal -> no item. Use it to filter publish_skillstation_items (bee-deploying, compared against the engine source rendered for claude) and publish_principle_items. Do not change apply.rs or the after_publish ordering. DOCS: in docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/skillstation-hub-skills-and-aliases.md Business Rules, state the publish filter in two or three sentences citing skillstation-publish-skip D1-D3 (never raw decision ids). Write docs/history/skillstation-publish-skip/delivery.md (what changed, the red and green test names, proof). One commit.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- skillstation onboard

truths: onboard --skillstation plans no publish_skillstation item for a skill active on the hub with the same per-file sha256 set
a missing, non-active or changed skill still gets a publish_skillstation item
a hub read that skips keeps every publish item
with zero publish items the switch still plans the after_publish principle removals and set_principles_hub
key_links: plan.rs reads the hub through hub_show, not a copy
the staged content is hashed with walk_skill_tree and the claude render
prohibitions: Onboard tests never call the real skillstation
open_choices: The helper name and where the hub set lives inside Hub
